primary: Original raw convergence rule, equal entry dollars, one session, existing costs, participation and wind-down
benchmark: Long the same leader on the same entries. Match the pair's estimated factor exposure by covariance-weighted projection, subject to observed volume and gross limits.
signed_hedge_diagnostic: Use trailing signed OLS slope of leader on laggard. Long the leader and hold minus that slope in the laggard, normalized to unit gross. Report separately from the original opposite-leg trade.
primary_endpoint: Paired daily net PnL of original pair less factor-matched leader, all pairs and excluding SCO/USO with fresh ranking
inference: Report both windows separately. Forward only: ten-session paired circular blocks, 95% intervals, two one-sided HAC tests Holm-corrected across the two universes. Report sample size without repeated interim selection.
execution_evidence: Report original bar-cost scenario separately from quote/locate evidence; never infer a historical locate from a present-day flag or from reported short-sale volume.
model_policy: No PPO, wavelet, threshold tuning or model selection during the forward period.
